meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: Codex 每次成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等改动后，插件会自动运行 comment-checker。若报出警告，Codex 会收到阻塞式反馈，需先修正或说明被标记的注释才能继续。
howto.when: 当 Codex 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等改动类操作成功后触发 PostToolUse 钩子；非改动类工具不触发。缺检查器二进制时不输出。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告，帮我改掉被标记的注释
say.note: Codex 会修改该注释，解除阻塞反馈

say.text: 说说 comment-checker 为什么标记这段注释
say.note: Codex 会给出说明而非直接改代码

say.text: 这条注释没过检查，按提示重写一下
say.note: Codex 按警告内容重写该注释

howto.what_en: After each successful apply_patch, write, or edit call, the plugin runs comment-checker automatically. If it reports a warning, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers on the PostToolUse hook after successful edit-like calls such as apply_patch, write, and edit; other tools are ignored. Nothing is emitted if the checker binary is missing.

say_en.text: comment-checker raised a warning — fix the flagged comment for me
say_en.note: Codex edits that comment to clear the blocking feedback

say_en.text: Explain why comment-checker flagged this comment
say_en.note: Codex explains instead of changing the code

say_en.text: This comment failed the check — rewrite it as suggested
say_en.note: Codex rewrites the comment per the warning
